channels.name: signal_state

channels.name: ego_body_vertices_xy_m
channels.method: Original same-frame complete ego body vertices in sourced junction coordinates

channels.name: ego_body_in_intersection
channels.method: Saved polygon overlap of complete original ego body against sourced junction polygon
channels.uncertainty: Geometric overlap does not settle the statutory entry reference point

channels.name: ego_approach_speed

channels.uncertainty: Speed alone does not establish yellow stopping feasibility
channels.reference_frame: Native map and original camera frames

context_inputs.name: junction_signal_context

context_inputs.uncertainty: Official governance and physical head visibility remain unresolved

limitations: CPU construction and synthetic diagnostic sources do not establish Native head visibility, physical timing, yellow stopping feasibility or legal compliance
